title: manufacturing.plan output
description: Per plan, in order: plans.product_plan's dict. per_unit is rounded DOWN to 0.01 g so the actual TPE never exceeds the dose; error is why it can't be made (null: it can).

potency.description: mg/g used: the higher of the state's figure and the certificate's potency (DOSE-25: the higher of its unrounded TPE and that TPE to 2 places; for a job queued before DOSE-25 its 2-place coa_tpe).

coa_tpe.description: The certificate's TPE to 2 places (the figure pages and labels show; for an item without coa, its coa_tpe as given), or null: no certificate TPE, or one that refuses the plan.

actual_mg.description: per_unit x potency, rounded up to 0.01 mg; never above the dose.
